title: Advanced Chemical Methods for Explosives Detection and Analysis: From Foundational Principles to AI-Driven Innovations
description: A comprehensive review of the current state and emerging trends in the chemistry of explosives detection and analysis, exploring the fundamental chemistry of explosives, advanced methodological approaches like spectrometry and spectroscopy, critical challenges in real-world application, and the transformative role of artificial intelligence in enhancing detection sensitivity, speed, and accuracy.
audience: Researchers and scientists in analytical chemistry and security fields
